name: Seated Forward Bend with a Strap
description: A seated forward bend with a strap looped round the soles of the feet, so you can fold from the hips with a long back instead of rounding to reach your toes.

source.title: Yoga Journal: Props for forward bends

setup: Sit with your legs straight out in front, a strap looped round the balls of both feet.
Hold an end of the strap in each hand.
cues: Sit up tall before you fold.
Walk your hands down the strap as you lengthen.
Lead with the chest, not the head.

keyframes.name: Sit in Staff Pose
keyframes.cue: Sit tall, legs straight, holding the strap round your feet.

keyframes.name: Seated Forward Bend
keyframes.cue: Hold the strap round your feet and fold forward from the hips, back long.
